label: Gorgias connections
description: Internal state for the Gorgias connection: OAuth tokens (written by the app's frontend Worker when the merchant connects), generated secrets, provisioned Gorgias ids and customer import progress. The app keeps a single record.

gorgias_subdomain.description: Helpdesk the merchant authorized (the acme in acme.gorgias.com)

access_token.description: Gorgias OAuth access token (24 hours). Renewed by reconcile through the Worker

refresh_token.description: Gorgias OAuth refresh token. Only the Worker can use it, since refreshing needs the client secret

refresh_key.description: Per-store key the Worker issued at connect; authorizes token refresh requests

oauth_service_url.description: Public URL of the app's Worker, which refreshes tokens

date_authorized.description: When the merchant last authorized the app in Gorgias. A new authorization re-provisions

oauth_nonce_hash.description: Hash of the one-time nonce for a connection in progress

oauth_subdomain.description: Helpdesk for the connection in progress

oauth_user_id.description: Dashboard user who started the connection in progress

oauth_error.description: Why the last connection attempt didn't finish, shown on the Connect page

events_secret.description: Generated secret Gorgias sends in the X-Swell-Gorgias-Secret header when calling gorgias-events

internal_secret.description: Generated secret the app's own functions send when calling the sync function. Never leaves Swell

fingerprint.description: Hash of the settings and URLs the Gorgias integration was last provisioned with. A change triggers re-provisioning

integration_id.description: Id of the Gorgias HTTP integration this app created

widget_id.description: Id of the Gorgias ticket sidebar widget this app created

gorgias_account.description: Gorgias helpdesk domain the app is connected to

last_error.description: Most recent connection error, cleared on success

last_attempt_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the last connection attempt, used to back off after a failure

date_connected.description: When the current settings were first provisioned successfully

date_checked.description: When the connection was last verified against Gorgias

backfill_subdomain.description: Gorgias subdomain the customer import ran for. A different subdomain starts a new import

backfill_page.description: Next page of customers to import

date_backfill_updated.description: Last progress on the import. The reconcile function restarts a stalled import from backfill_page
